# Walking in My Sleep

"Walking in My Sleep" is a song written by Leslie Adey and Jack Green and recorded by the English singer Roger Daltrey for his fifth solo studio album Parting Should Be Painless (1984). The single was produced by Mike Thorne, with executive producer listed as "Spike". This is presumably the same woman who was credited as executive producer of Pete Townshend's compilation album Scoop (1983), later revealed to be Helen Wilkins.
The single, "Walking in My Sleep", peaked at number 4 on the Billboards Mainstream Rock Charts and number 40 on the Netherlands's MegaCharts the single also reached No. 56 on the UK singles charts and No. 62 on the US singles charts and No. 19 on the Austrian Singles Charts.
The single's music video featured Ian Dury, who was best known as the lead singer of the British band Ian Dury and the Blockheads.
